collection_runs_lease_state.name: collection_runs_lease_state
collection_runs_lease_state.value:
("collection_runs"."status" = 'running' AND "collection_runs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND
      "collection_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "collection_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("collection_runs"."status" <> 'running' AND "collection_runs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND
      "collection_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "collection_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

job_discovery_runs_counts_nonnegative.name: job_discovery_runs_counts_nonnegative
job_discovery_runs_counts_nonnegative.value:
"job_discovery_runs"."sources_attempted" >= 0 AND "job_discovery_runs"."sources_succeeded" >= 0 AND "job_discovery_runs"."sources_failed" >= 0 AND
    "job_discovery_runs"."jobs_discovered" >= 0 AND "job_discovery_runs"."jobs_inserted" >= 0 AND "job_discovery_runs"."jobs_updated" >= 0 AND
    "job_discovery_runs"."jobs_verified" >= 0 AND "job_discovery_runs"."jobs_marked_closed" >= 0 AND
    "job_discovery_runs"."jobs_pending_verification" >= 0 AND "job_discovery_runs"."jobs_unchanged" >= 0

job_discovery_runs_lease_state.name: job_discovery_runs_lease_state
job_discovery_runs_lease_state.value:
("job_discovery_runs"."status" = 'running' AND "job_discovery_runs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "job_discovery_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "job_discovery_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("job_discovery_runs"."status" <> 'running' AND "job_discovery_runs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "job_discovery_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "job_discovery_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_salary_complete.name: jobs_salary_complete
jobs_salary_complete.value:
("jobs"."salary_min" IS NULL AND "jobs"."salary_max" IS NULL AND "jobs"."salary_currency" IS NULL AND "jobs"."salary_pay_period" IS NULL) OR
    (("jobs"."salary_min" IS NOT NULL OR "jobs"."salary_max" IS NOT NULL) AND "jobs"."salary_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND "jobs"."salary_pay_period" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_salary_range.name: jobs_salary_range
jobs_salary_range.value:
("jobs"."salary_min" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_min" >= 0) AND
    ("jobs"."salary_max" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_max" >= 0) AND
    ("jobs"."salary_min" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_max" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_max" >= "jobs"."salary_min")

jobs_deadline_after_publication.name: jobs_deadline_after_publication
jobs_deadline_after_publication.value: "jobs"."published_at" IS NULL OR "jobs"."application_deadline" IS NULL OR "jobs"."application_deadline" >= "jobs"."published_at"

jobs_missing_state.name: jobs_missing_state
jobs_missing_state.value:
("jobs"."missing_observation_count" = 0 AND "jobs"."missing_since" IS NULL) OR
    ("jobs"."missing_observation_count" > 0 AND "jobs"."missing_since" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_closure_state.name: jobs_closure_state
jobs_closure_state.value:
("jobs"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "jobs"."closure_reason" IS NULL) OR
    ("jobs"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."closure_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."status" IN ('closed', 'expired'))

source_items_verified_details.name: source_items_verified_details
source_items_verified_details.value: "source_items"."verification_status" <> 'verified' OR ("source_items"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "source_items"."verification_notes" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("source_items"."verification_notes")) > 0)

stories_verified_details.name: stories_verified_details
stories_verified_details.value: "stories"."verification_status" <> 'verified' OR ("stories"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stories"."verification_notes" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("stories"."verification_notes")) > 0)
